messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydroxyzine is a prescription antihistamine.
It is used to treat anxiety and tension.
It is used to treat itching from allergic skin conditions.
It is used for sedation before and after general anesthesia.
Hydroxyzine comes in three oral forms:
Hydroxyzine hydrochloride (HCl) tablets in 10 mg, 25 mg, and 50 mg strengths
Hydroxyzine hydrochloride oral solution (a syrup) containing 10 mg in each 5 mL
Hydroxyzine pamoate capsules in 25 mg
There is also a hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection.
Hydroxyzine is given into a muscle by a healthcare professional.
It is never given into a vein or under the skin.
Hydroxyzine is not chemically related to benzodiazepines, phenothiazines, reserpine, or meprobamate.

The relation 'not chemically related to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is not considered addictive': The subject drug is not considered addictive in the manner or context specified by the object entity.
B. 'does not show up on': The subject drug is not typically detected by the type of test specified by the object entity.
C. 'not classified under': The subject drug is not classified under the regulatory category or legal framework specified by the object entity.
